draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Patnem! You're in Canacona's beach belt at the far south of Goa, a stretch that was only really 'discovered' after the 1990s.
draft.hungryLine: Most of the eating happens along neighbouring Palolem beach, and Goan dishes are the favourites at the better spots.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Mallikarjun Temple is 2.5 km from Chaudi on the road towards Karwar, and Cabo de Rama Fort is great for coast views if you have your own wheels.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Canacona has nearly 20 lesser-known beaches beyond Palolem and Agonda, some reached only by a narrow track, perfect for escaping it all.
moodReplies.surprise-me: King's beer is local to Goa and isn't sold outside the state, and plenty of locals swear by it.

spots.name: Cabo de Rama Fort

legends.title: Flower petal oracles
legends.body: Devotees come here for advice from the oracles. The answer is read from where the flower petals drop.

legends.title: The Betal statue
legends.body: Cultural historian Phaldessai says Loliem's statue of Betal, possibly a pre-Hindu deity, goes back to at least the seventh century. He counts four Betal deities in Canacona.

tips.title: Get your own wheels.
tips.body: Public buses are few and far between, so you need your own transport for Cabo de Rama and the quieter beaches.

tips.title: Come once the season starts.
tips.body: Extra beach shacks pop up along the coast when the foreign tourist season begins.

story.title: Betal of Loliem
story.body: Nearby Loliem's statue of Betal may date to the seventh century or earlier. The village also has centuries-old hero stones recording events of the time.

story.title: Parthagal math
story.body: The monastery at Parthagal has stood for about five centuries.

story.title: A beach belt found
story.body: Canacona's beaches were only 'discovered' after the 1990s, and now rank among Goa's most scenic.

story.title: Still unhurried
story.body: Palolem and Agonda are still not overdeveloped, and dolphin watching and fishing trips bring visitors to the area.
